chosen_by: scale_story rule in wall_manifest.json (motion-matched across the five families); legged swapped to the wall's Gendog224, frame closest to the window centre (none inside)
residual_note: Section 3 draws R = F - H on frame 1 (F = gt, H = harmonic_2) under one common magnification, then R / (s_hat * normalizer); s_hat is in the model's units and normalizer converts it to the clip's units
source: the wall clip's own completion of this frame (same mask, xm2_unified, k = 8, 30 ODE steps)
score_definition: err/|F| over the scored unobserved vertices. err_over_F = sum over steps and vertices of |pred-F| over sum of |F| (ratio of aggregates); mean_of_steps = mean over steps of the per-step ratio. One step: frame 1 against the zero source frame 0.

layout.FIELD: float32 translation [T,3] then float16 residual [T,N,3]; value[t,v] = translation[t] + residual[t,v]
layout.gt.bin: FIELD: ground-truth displacement from the rest vertices
layout.src.bin: FIELD: each step's source-frame displacement (sequences only)
layout.harmonic_<key>.bin / ours_<key>.bin: FIELD of (method - gt); method displacement = gt + value

bytes_gate.rule: err/|F| recomputed from the decoded files within 0.1% of the float64 score
